session.title: Resequenced Suito 3x8 tempo/torque development
session.purpose: Recover the sustained bike-specific aerobic and muscular-endurance stimulus that Monday's short assisted test ride did not provide, without converting the week into consecutive intensity days.

dose.fresh_admission_gate: The live Garmin workflow is current. Start only with mental clarity at least 8/10, normal breathing at rest, no current sore throat, runny nose, cough, wheeze, chest tightness, unusual fatigue, illness, gastrointestinal disturbance or pain, and symmetric normal legs. Today's CNS watch is acceptable only because it is driven by short sleep without impaired/compromised signals; any subjective processing or coordination concern selects the fallback or rest.
dose.clean_air_gate: Keep doors and windows closed and particle filtration running. Use the indoor PM2.5 monitor as exposure context, not a guarantee of safety. Do not start if the reading is rising, smoke odour is present, or eye, nose or throat irritation appears indoors.
dose.warm_up: Ride 12-15 minutes seated, progressing from 105 W toward 140 W. Confirm normal breathing, expected HR response, stable cadence and posture before beginning structured work.
dose.main_set: Complete 3x8 minutes seated at 165-168 W, cadence 70-75 rpm and RPE 5-6, with 4 minutes at 100-115 W between repetitions. Rep three may touch 170 W only if rep two finishes at RPE 5 or lower with normal HR, breathing, cadence and posture. Do not add the previously optional 175 W finish.
dose.cool_down: Ride 8-10 minutes at 100-115 W. Total duration 58-66 minutes.
dose.fallback: If respiratory symptoms are absent but readiness, sleep or leg response is merely yellow, replace the structured set with 30-40 minutes at 110-120 W and RPE 2. Any respiratory or irritation symptom selects complete rest.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Twenty-four controlled minutes at 78-81 percent of the current 211 W Garmin operational FTP will rebuild sustained bike-specific aerobic and torque durability. Keeping Wednesday low-cost allows this stimulus to be absorbed before Friday's protected Enduro exposure.
execution_rules: Use strong internal fan cooling, remain seated and keep the established 12 mm aft saddle position unchanged.
Power and form govern the repetitions; HR is a response signal and must not be chased.

Eat a normal carbohydrate-containing meal. If the last meal was more than three hours earlier, take 20-30 g carbohydrate before or during the ride. Drink approximately 500-750 ml per hour with sodium according to indoor sweat loss.
No standing torque, cadence drills, fourth repetition, extra watts or post-session volume.
Finish early enough to protect the planned 23:00 sleep opportunity and US-market-work cutoff.
Wednesday is recovery or low-cost continuity only; do not add Twin Peaks, VO2, threshold or sprint work.

garmin_training_load.basis: Yellow-capped athlete-specific range for controlled 3x8 Suito work; execution quality and next-day absorption matter more than matching the point estimate.

expected_result.session: All repetitions remain within approximately 3 percent power spread, cadence and posture stay stable, rep three remains RPE 6 or lower, and no respiratory irritation appears.
expected_result.next_day: Normal cognition, breathing and legs with no disproportionate RHR, HRV, Body Battery, sleep, airway, knee, back, hand or fit cost. Wednesday remains deliberately low-cost even after a green response.

stop_rules: Do not start, or stop immediately, for sore throat, runny nose, cough, wheeze, chest tightness, unusual shortness of breath, eye irritation, smoke odour, dizziness or headache.
End the structured set for pain, an abnormal HR response relative to power and cooling, posture or cadence collapse, power loss above 5 percent, or if repetition two already exceeds RPE 6.
Do not convert stopped intervals into extra easy duration or move the missing work into Wednesday.
